description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
When Lotus Petal enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Lotus Petal.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2
